payload.text: (2026-09-18, vc under hv's pen, CORRECTING vc DECISION 35 FORWARD on one sentence) Decision 35 says 3.53.2 "adds `fts5: missing row %lld from content table %s`, which is 0442's exact damage named natively with the offending rowid", and 0442's body said the same at 47c883c37. MEASURED FALSE by cc on 2026-09-18: fts5's integrity check on the real 0442 damage, run on both 3.53.2 (the pair) and 3.54 (the CLI), reports `fts5: checksum mismatch for table "src_sections"` and never reaches the missing-row string, which exists in the source and is not what this damage triggers. The row is named by the A2 anti-join (fts5vocab against %_content, docid 2599), not by fts5. HOW IT ENTERED: cc read the string in the 3.53.2 source, vc ruled on the read, and neither ran the check against the damage until the detector did. WHAT STANDS: the bump's real reason, the WAL-reset defect fixed in 3.51.3, and the detector's need for 3.46.1's fix to secure-delete false positives; the order; the patch-id 53a863458. 0442's body is corrected forward through `intent issues edit --from`; the landed commit message 47e269483 carries the false sentence and is corrected forward in the detector's commit message (decision 7: corrected forward, never rewritten).
